snippet.title: Starfinder: Afterlight – Official Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description: Starfinder: Afterlight is a new "science-fantasy" turn-based RPG due to launch into Early Access on PC in 2026. In a quest to save the universe from total destruction, you'll build your own character and lead the crew of a vanished captain. Those companions will play a big part in this RPG, which is based on the Starfinder tabletop game's Second Edition rules. Their Kickstarter campaign launches on October 7. Check out their Kickstarter page for more: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/epictellers/starfinder-afterlight
